meta.problem: "Run the whole thing", starting with the cartoon channel, with no channel yet.

agent.name: cartoon-writers-room
agent.model_rationale: Newest Opus-class (the default): creative quality and rule-following across 15 strict prompts matter most; a weekly run costs cents.
agent.system_summary: Writers' room for a family-friendly faceless 3D cartoon Shorts channel: creates an original series bible on the first run, then writes 5 episodes a week (Wan2GP scene prompts, narration, YouTube package) to /mnt/session/outputs/.
never_dos: Never use branded, trademarked or third-party characters, songs or logos
Never write anything scary, violent or unsafe to imitate
Never mark the content as 'made for kids'
Never post, upload or contact anyone: files only

outcome.description: first_prompt.txt: this week's writers' room session (creates the channel on the first run)
rubric_criteria: Series bible in memory: name, 3-line personality, 2 friends, 3 locations, style string; unchanged on later runs
Exactly 5 new episodes: title ≤5 words, 2-line story, 3 scenes, warm ending
All 15 scene prompts Wan2GP-ready: style string first, one action, camera move last, <45 words, no text; scene-queue.json valid
YouTube package per episode: title <40 chars starting with the character's name, 2-line description, 5 hashtags, ≤2-sentence narration
No repeats vs episode-log.md; this week's episodes appended
Family-friendly and original: nothing scary, no branded characters, a wink for adults, not labelled made-for-kids

connections.notes: No connectors in v0. ElevenLabs (v2), render API (v3), YouTube (v1/v5) are planned with vault credentials.

stores.name: writers-room-memory
stores.purpose: series-bible.md (canon) + episode-log.md (every episode) so the character stays consistent and premises never repeat.

schedule.kickoff: user.define_outcome (first_prompt.txt + outcome.md, max_iterations 3): relative wording only

cases.name: case-02
cases.expected: same character + style string, no repeated premises, log appended

evals.notes: Synthesized: no past episodes exist. Case 2 runs on a scratch memory store so the live canon is untouched.

defaults_applied.write_actions: None: the agent writes files, you post

interface.how: Fetch week.md + scene-queue.json each Sunday; Console for run history; overview page for the map.

next_directions.what: Weekly review shapes the next batch
next_directions.why_deferred: Needs real posts first; auto-pull needs YouTube Analytics credential
next_directions.how: /performance.md in memory, then YouTube Analytics API via vault

next_directions.why_deferred: Not possible in the CPU sandbox (Wan2GP needs a GPU)
next_directions.how: Hosted video API or rented GPU endpoint fed from scene-queue.json

next_directions.what: Re-run evals before promoting a new agent version
